title: When the Ledger Wakes
author: Coral Galloway
blurb: Jude Okafor, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
